source.note: The primary twelve-verse Sanskrit text follows the Sringeri Bhagavatpadiyam reading. The English translation and word-level gloss are original.

units.label: Verse 1
units.deva:
निमित्तं मनश्चक्षुरादिप्रवृत्तौ
निरस्ताखिलोपाधिराकाशकल्पः ।
रविर्लोकचेष्टानिमित्तं यथा यः
स नित्योपलब्धिस्वरूपोऽहमात्मा ॥१॥
units.translation: I am the Self, whose nature is ever-present awareness and who is the occasion for the activity of mind, eye, and the rest, as the sun is for the world's activity. Free of every limiting adjunct, I am like space.

gloss.en: the cause of the world's activity

units.label: Verse 2
units.deva:
यमग्न्युष्णवन्नित्यबोधस्वरूपं
मनश्चक्षुरादीन्यबोधात्मकानि ।
प्रवर्तन्त आश्रित्य निष्कम्पमेकं
स नित्योपलब्धिस्वरूपोऽहमात्मा ॥२॥
units.translation: I am the Self, the one unmoving ground of ever-present awareness, like fire's heat in being inseparable from its nature. Mind, eye, and the other faculties, though themselves insentient, function by depending on it.

gloss.en: of the nature of ever-present awareness

units.label: Verse 3
units.deva:
मुखाभासको दर्पणे दृश्यमानो
मुखत्वात् पृथक्त्वेन नैवास्ति वस्तु ।
चिदाभासको धीषु जीवोऽपि तद्वत्
स नित्योपलब्धिस्वरूपोऽहमात्मा ॥३॥
units.translation: A face seen in a mirror as a reflection is no real thing separate from the face. Likewise, the individual appears in intellects as a reflection of consciousness, yet is not separate from it. I am that Self, ever-present awareness.

gloss.en: because it is the face itself

units.label: Verse 4
units.deva:
यथा दर्पणाभाव आभासहानौ
मुखं विद्यते कल्पनाहीनमेकम् ।
तथा धीवियोगे निराभासको यः
स नित्योपलब्धिस्वरूपोऽहमात्मा ॥४॥
units.translation: When the mirror is gone and the reflection disappears, the single face remains, free from imagined doubling. So, when the intellect is absent, the one without reflection remains. I am that ever-present Self.

units.label: Verse 5
units.deva:
मनश्चक्षुरादेर्वियुक्तः स्वयं यो
मनश्चक्षुरादेर्मनश्चक्षुरादिः ।
मनश्चक्षुरादेरगम्यस्वरूपः
स नित्योपलब्धिस्वरूपोऽहमात्मा ॥५॥
units.translation: I am the Self, distinct from mind, eye, and the rest, yet the awareness that makes mind, eye, and the rest possible. My nature cannot be reached by those faculties; I am ever-present awareness.

gloss.en: from mind, eye, and the rest
of mind, eye, and the rest
the mind of mind, eye of eye, and so on

units.label: Verse 6
units.deva:
य एको विभाति स्वतः शुद्धचेताः
प्रकाशस्वरूपोऽपि नानेव धीषु ।
शरावोदकस्थो यथा भानुरेकः
स नित्योपलब्धिस्वरूपोऽहमात्मा ॥६॥
units.translation: I am the one Self, pure awareness, shining by itself. Though its nature is light, it seems manifold in different intellects, as one sun appears in the water held in many vessels.

gloss.en: though of the nature of light
seen in water held in vessels
of the nature of ever-present awareness

units.label: Verse 7
units.deva:
यथानेकचक्षुःप्रकाशो रविर्न
क्रमेण प्रकाशीकरोति प्रकाश्यम् ।
अनेका धियो यस्तथैकप्रबोधः
स नित्योपलब्धिस्वरूपोऽहमात्मा ॥७॥
units.translation: As the sun makes visible what is before many eyes all at once, not one after another, so I am the single awareness that illumines many intellects at the same time.

gloss.en: of the nature of ever-present awareness

units.label: Verse 8
units.deva:
विवस्वत्प्रभातं यथारूपमक्षं
प्रगृह्णाति नाभातमेवं विवस्वान् ।
यदाभात आभासयत्यक्षमेकः
स नित्योपलब्धिस्वरूपोऽहमात्मा ॥८॥
units.translation: As the eye apprehends a form revealed by the sun, but not one left unlit, so the single Self illumines the eye itself. I am that ever-present awareness by which even the sun is known.

units.label: Verse 9
units.deva:
यथा सूर्य एकोऽप्स्वनेकश्चलासु
स्थिरास्वप्यनन्वग्विभाव्यस्वरूपः ।
चलासु प्रभिन्नासु धीष्वेवमेकः
स नित्योपलब्धिस्वरूपोऽहमात्मा ॥९॥
units.translation: One sun appears as many in waters that move or stand still, yet it does not move with them. So the one Self appears among distinct, changing intellects without itself becoming divided. I am that ever-present awareness.

gloss.en: in moving and still waters alike
not following their movement in its own nature
of the nature of ever-present awareness

units.label: Verse 10
units.deva:
घनच्छन्नदृष्टिर्घनच्छन्नमर्कं
यथा निष्प्रभं मन्यते चातिमूढः ।
तथा बद्धवद्भाति यो मूढदृष्टेः
स नित्योपलब्धिस्वरूपोऽहमात्मा ॥१०॥
units.translation: As a person whose sight is clouded foolishly thinks the cloud-covered sun has lost its light, so to the deluded the Self appears bound. I am that Self, ever-present awareness.

gloss.en: one whose sight is covered by a cloud

units.label: Verse 11
units.deva:
समस्तेषु वस्तुष्वनुस्यूतमेकं
समस्तानि वस्तूनि यं न स्पृशन्ति ।
वियद्वत्सदा शुद्धमच्छस्वरूपं
स नित्योपलब्धिस्वरूपोऽहमात्मा ॥११॥
units.translation: I am the one Self threaded through all things, yet untouched by anything. Ever pure like space, clear in nature, I am the Self of ever-present awareness.

units.label: Verse 12
units.deva:
उपाधौ यथा भेदता सन्मणीनां
तथा भेदता बुद्धिभेदेषु तेऽपि ।
यथा चन्द्रिकाणां जले चञ्चलत्वं
तथा चञ्चलत्वं तवापीह विष्णो ॥१२॥
units.translation: Just as clear gems seem different under differing adjuncts, so do you seem varied in the distinct intellects. As moonlight appears to waver in water, so you too seem to waver here, O Viṣṇu.
